serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Listen… Could I pay for that family? If their situation is so bad I don’t mind helping them a little.
Landlord: ...You want to pay for them?{{wi}} ARE YOU CRAZY?! Do you really think that only because you got some more money you are in a position to place yourself on some kind of moral high ground? Don’t make me laugh!
You: W-what’s so wrong about helping people!
Landlord: Will you help them only this week? What about next week and the week after that? Are you going to pay for them forever?
You: I-I don’t think so…
Landlord: Listen buddy, no matter how much cash you throw at people like them, things will never change. Our country sends BILLIONS of sweet American dollars to some God forsaken countries to help them, but it never is enough and it never will be!
Landlord: It’s not about money, kid! It’s about an ability to adapt and overcome everything life has thrown at you! Some people, like them for example, will have to learn this the hard way and you can only postpone it.
Landlord: And if you can’t understand this argument, here is another one. Do you really think they would help you if it was you being kicked out? Don’t make me laugh!
Landlord: That’s how this world is. Every man for himself!
You: W-what do you mean by this? What are they supposed to do in this situation?!
Landlord: For example… {{wi}}Buy a cheaper medication. {{wi}}Or they could just leave the little girl in the hands of God.
You: Wha?!
Landlord: Listen kid, these parents are still young, you know what I mean? They can have 4, no, even 5 new children! Tough times require tough thinking.
You: T-that’s just...
Landlord: You must think I’m cruel, don’t you? The truth is you are the cruel one, having them live in a fantasy for another week. 
Landlord: I’m not saying it’s an easy decision, to abandon your own blood, but sometimes it’s the only smart decision available and you gotta be smart, always!
Landlord: After hearing this, do you still want to pay for them? It’s 1200$ may I add. Don’t take me wrong, this money still goes to me at the end of the day haha! If you really want to pay for them then I guess I have no choice~
